title: Renice Squared
description: An edit of the Renice Cubed, removing advantage-giving features.
body:
Renice Squared is a lightweight modpack for players who want useful HUD improvements, basic QoL features, and better performance without powerful tools that may be considered unfair on public servers.

## Main Features

### Lightweight compared to Renice Cubed

This modpack keeps the lighter side of Renice Cubed, but without mods that give an unfair advantage.
Compared to Renice Cubed, Renice Squared does not include stronger client utilities such as maps, schematic tools, precise block placement, technical overlays, recipe browsers, or advanced gameplay tweak systems.

Choose Renice Squared if you want:

* Better performance
* Fewer powerful utility tools
* A simpler setup for large public servers

Choose Renice Cubed if you want a larger client setup with navigation, building tools, recipe browsing, and technical overlays.

### UI&HUD

This pack improves the information you see during regular gameplay. It shows hunger and saturation values, food recovery previews, effect duration bars, and a better riding HUD that keeps your food bar and mount health visible while mounted.

It also adds configurable zoom, a much longer chat scrollback, faster language switching, 2160p screenshot support even if you don't have a 4K screen, and cleaner access to settings and mod configs.

### Performance and Responsiveness

The pack includes a set of optimization mods selected to improve rendering, memory usage, loading behavior, entity handling, block entity rendering, background resource usage, and general client responsiveness.

Performance related mods include:

* Sodium
* Lithium
* FerriteCore
* ImmediatelyFast
* ModernFix
* BadOptimizations
* Entity Culling
* More Culling
* Dynamic FPS
* Clumps
* Better Block Entities
* Debugify
* Ixeris

### Visuals

It improves the visual side of Minecraft while keeping the pack client side and familiar.

Included visual and compatibility features include:

* Shader support through Iris
* Extra video settings through Sodium Extra and Reese's Sodium Options
* Connected textures through Continuity
* Entity model and texture compatibility through Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features
* Improved player skin rendering through 3D Skin Layers
* Dynamic lighting through LambDynamicLights
* Custom GUI and resource pack compatibility through OptiGUI and Puzzle
* Animated texture support through Animatica Refabricated
